_about: Core Candy Machine config skeleton for the 48 Alley Kingz playable stat-cards. Deployed on e5-mother via Sugar / mpl-core-candy-machine (NOT the phone). Operator fills every <PLACEHOLDER> and signs with the Phantom wallet (@bcardi, 2ef4VfuyRNYwu6WMW9TCz8cXpiqi23MSd8y8ZFyUmrBg). Confirmed live 2026-06-03: mpl-core-candy-machine with TokenPayment guard. See RUNBOOK.md.
_doctrine: FREE-FIRST: only on-chain cost is mint rent (~0.0029-0.0037 SOL/card, ~34 USD for all 48). No SaaS, no audit bill (Metaplex programs are audited). GATED-ON-FUNDING: wallet must hold SOL for rent before deploy. GATED-ON-ART: do not deploy until the 48 animation_url clips + images are uploaded and CIDs are swapped into asset_config.json + the per-card metadata.

collection._note: Address of the Core Collection created in RUNBOOK step 3. Fill after collection create.

_itemsNote: 48 = the v1.0 Genesis card SET (one Candy Machine item config per distinct card). Per-card EDITION supply (how many copies of each card can mint) is enforced by the Genesis ladder below, NOT by itemsAvailable. See _editionsDecision.
_sellerFeeNote: 2.5% royalty (250 bps) to treasury, matches AlleyKingzMarketplace.sol ROYALTY_BPS and ECOSYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE 4.4.
_isMutableNote: Mutable so the treasury update-authority can patch on-chain Attribute-Plugin stats in a balance update. Players cannot edit their own card (authority-gated, not owner-gated).

configLineSettings._note: Names/URIs come from the per-card metadata in ./metadata/. prefixName mirrors the collection display name; prefixUri is the metadata CID base after upload.

guards._guardNote: Composable Candy Guard set. $BCARDD is the mint currency (tokenPayment). Coin-holder allowlist + start date + bot tax are the launch guards. Fill amounts/addresses before deploy.

tokenPayment._desc: Mint price paid in $BCARDD SPL token. amount is in base units of the $BCARDD mint (respect its decimals). destinationAta = treasury token account.

solPayment._desc: OPTIONAL alternate door: allow SOL-priced mint alongside $BCARDD (two-door funnel per ECOSYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE 2.3). Remove this block to make the drop $BCARDD-only. Leave null to disable.

botTax._desc: Bot protection: penalize invalid mint attempts.

mintLimit._desc: Per-wallet cap to keep the drop fair.

allowList._desc: Coin-holder whitelist (the $BCARDD-holder early-access tier from the cross-perk matrix). merkleRoot of eligible wallets, built on e5-mother.

groups._desc: OPTIONAL phased groups (whitelist window then public). Default single-phase: leave empty and rely on the top-level guards. Fill if you want a WL price/time distinct from public.

_editionsDecision.status: RESOLVED by ECOSYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md section 3.3 (Genesis scarcity ladder). NOT 1-of-1 across the board.
_editionsDecision.model: Master collection of 48 UNIQUE card characters; each character mints as a capped Genesis edition. Per-character edition cap drives the floor + Seedance video priority.

genesisEditionCaps.Common: uncapped (route Commons to Bubblegum V2 compressed NFTs, cents to mint -- FREE-FIRST)

_editionsDecision.implementationNote: Core Candy Machine enforces caps via per-config-line supply / separate machines per rarity tier, OR mint Mythic/Legendary/Epic/Rare as Core assets here and split Commons to a Bubblegum V2 cNFT machine in the same Core collection. Operator confirms the exact ladder ahead of deploy (CHAIN_DECISION_MEMO open item 3 -- e.g. $BCARDD #0001 may be 1-of-1 or a tiny cap).
_editionsDecision.operatorFlag: CONFIRM the exact per-card edition ladder (especially whether $BCARDD #0001 is 1-of-1) before the Candy Machine deploy. Default = the ladder above.
